title: Raw evaluation under Ext-to-derived comparison
statement: Let f:X to S be a scheme morphism, G a quasi-coherent module on X, q a natural number, V an etale S-scheme and z a raw higher-direct-image class on V. Apply affineRealizationRawEquiv(f,G,q,V) and then sheafHToDerived to z. The result equals rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison(f,q,lifted G,V)(z) followed by derived cohomology of the single-complex map induced by coherentEtaleRestrictionIso(pullback.snd(V.hom,f),G).hom. Dependencies: [def-weil-pbc-coherent-higher-image-classes], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-presentation].

source.place: Tag 03Q8, lemma-higher-direct-images, restriction of cohomology classes; Descent Tag 03DR, tensor-section restriction.

proof.text:
expand affineRealizationRawEquiv into rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison,
the inverse of sheafHDerivedEquiv, and cohomology of coherentEtaleRestrictionIso.
Apply sheafHToDerived_map to the last coefficient morphism. The forward map of
sheafHDerivedEquiv is sheafHToDerived by its construction from Equiv.ofBijective;
hence it cancels its inverse. The remaining composite is precisely the right hand
side. This assertion concerns the evaluation equivalence alone and has no chart
restriction or scalar. In degree zero the same inverse cancellation applies,
and the empty chart and zero coefficient cases require no nonzero generator.

lean.statement: theorem raw_evaluation_formula_aux {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) (V : S.Etale) (z : (Etale.abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf f q (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G)).obj (op V)) : Etale.sheafHToDerived (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V)) q (affineRealizationRawEquiv f G q V z) = (Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (Limits.pullback V.hom f) (q : ℤ)).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map (coherentEtaleRestrictionIso (pullback.snd V.hom f) G).hom)) (Etale.rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison f q (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G) V z)
